content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download the application format from www.echs.gov.in or obtain details from Station HQ Abohar. Fill out the application form as per the required format. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational Qualification and work experience. Include mark sheets, degrees, discharge book, PPO, service records, and two PP size colour photographs. Submit the complete application by post to Station HQ (ECHS) Abohar (Punjab)-152116. Ensure the application reaches on or before 16 Oct 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification certificates and mark sheets (Matric, 10+2, graduation/post graduation/diploma/course) Work experience certificates Discharge book PPO (Pension Payment Order) Service records Two passport size colour photographs

content_sections.heading: ECHS Medical Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Contract is for a period of one year for ESM and 11 months for civilian candidates. Candidate selected for the post of Medical Officer will carryout a 10 days OJT with previous incumbent and obtain a certificate before signing the contract. Duration of OJT will remain unpaid. Any application received after 16 Oct 2026 will not be accepted. Candidates must reach Station HQ Abohar at 1000 hours on 21 Oct 2026 for the interview carrying original certificates. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Applications are liable to be rejected if they are unsigned, incomplete, or lack necessary documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is ECHS Medical Officer & Nursing Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Station HQ (ECHS) Abohar to engage Medical and Para Medical Staff on a contractual basis at ECHS Polyclinic, Type 'E' (Mobile) Abohar.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced in the notification, distributed between Medical Officer and Nursing Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 16 Oct 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree with a minimum of 3 years experience after internship, with preferable additional qualifications in Medicine or Surgery.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Nursing Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates need a GNM Diploma or Class I Nursing Course from the Armed Forces along with a minimum of 5 years experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply through offline mode by submitting the application in the required format along with self-attested photocopies of testimonials to Station HQ (ECHS) Abohar.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of an interview scheduled for 21 Oct 2026 at 1100 hours.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration for the Medical Officer post is Rs. 95,000 per month.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 21 Oct 2026 at 1100 hours at Station HQ Abohar, with candidate reporting at 1000 hours.
